prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ reviseAsset }`. `reviseAsset(asset, patch)` updates an asset record containing exactly `assetId`, `label`, `category`, and `active`. Both arguments must be non-null, non-array objects; otherwise throw `TypeError`. Reject unknown patch keys and attempts to patch `assetId` with `TypeError`. The original asset must have a non-empty string `assetId`, `label`, and `category`, plus a boolean `active`; invalid values throw `TypeError`. Patched strings are trimmed and must remain non-empty, otherwise throw `RangeError`; `active` must be boolean. An empty patch returns an equal but distinct record. Return fields in the order `assetId`, `label`, `category`, `active`. Never mutate or alias either input.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
